entities.summary: Zygmunt Podhorski was Brigadier General of the Polish Army. Born May 25, 1891, Podhorski fought in World War I, Polish–Soviet War and the Invasion of Poland. Altogether, he served in the military from 1914 until 1946. He died in 1960 in London.
